lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular spots are distributed across the mid-lateral flank in a grid-like configuration posterior to the gill slits, with inter-spot distances increasing towards the posterior.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary circular blobs, particularly visible in the central flank region, forming a discernible grid structure.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single, well-defined horizontal ridge is visible in the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with higher intensity on the dorsal side and shadowing on the ventral side.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, circular, translucent elevated feature is visible on the mid-posterior flank, likely an attached organism or a localized lesion.
other_distinctive_markers: The visible portion of the pectoral fin displays a significantly higher density and smaller diameter of high-luminance spots compared to the adjacent lateral body surface.
